name: Zver'
source:
The story of two ordinary guys trapped in a war, facing a difficult choice: inevitable doom tomorrow or the shame of desertion today.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445290/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
兩個普通年輕人被困在戰火之中，面前只有一道難題：是等著明天必死無疑，還是今天就背上逃兵的恥辱？

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445290/]Steam[/url]］
